description.en: Enables or disables ground-snapping for a character, i.e. whether the engine automatically aligns the character's vertical position to the map's ground/terrain height.
True to keep the character snapped to the ground, false to let it float free (e.g. while manually animating its position).
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Free the character from ground snapping to move it manually
CMND_SET_CHARA_GROUND(hHayamiL, false);
